name: dropframe
description: Edit like a motion designer. Turn your footage, brand kit and a song into a beat-synced, After-Effects-quality trailer, with sync you can measure and no AI look.

interface.longDescription: Edit like a motion designer: a beat grid fitted to your song, every cut on a strong kick, a build-up and drop remixed from your own track, AE-grade easing and motion blur, layered depth, one continuous visual world, and sync measured in milliseconds.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30s trailer from my footage, synced to this song.
Re-edit this video onto a new track and make the drop hit harder.
Turn my brand kit and this song into a beat-synced reel.
